capability.title: Employer-Origin and Connector Lifecycle Consolidation
capability.outcome: Each discovery, repair, gate, build, validation, registration and activation boundary has one authoritative owner.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical lifecycle and ownership map exists.
Duplicate decision logic is removed or explicitly compatibility-only.
validation: Architecture tests and capability audit evidence.

stories.title: Canonical Connector Lifecycle Responsibility Contract
stories.outcome: One ordered contract names the owner and handoff for candidacy, build, validation, registration, approval and activation.
acceptance_criteria: Every stage has one authoritative owner and side-effect class.

stories.title: Connector Agent Consolidation Plan
stories.outcome: Fragmented agents are kept, merged, narrowed or archived deliberately.

stories.title: URL Discovery Repair Persistence Ownership
stories.outcome: Discovery, repair, validation and persistence are separate and non-overlapping.
acceptance_criteria: Each URL state transition has owner, evidence and rollback.

stories.title: Connector Write-Boundary Hardening
stories.outcome: Build/registration/activation scripts share explicit dry-run/apply and approval semantics.
validation: Capability tests and DB integration tests.

stories.title: Connector and Source Health Read Models
stories.outcome: Staleness, failures and controlled-source health are visible without implying activation success.
acceptance_criteria: Health freshness and evidence source are explicit.
